result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a loading spinner overlay is persistently displayed on top of a restaurant card image in the 'Popular right now' section, making the content look broken.

issues.description: A white circular loading/progress indicator with a green arc is overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar food image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the restaurant's photo.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading overlay once the image has finished loading, or replace it with the actual loaded restaurant image so the card displays correctly.
